draft_message.body: Call brief: The Bentley Continental GT on CD-420322 is stopped in a service-area car park between Munich and Hamburg. The engine is off and the driver is safe and staying with the car. Symptom: a red dashboard warning and weaker acceleration. It has not been diagnosed. The location pin and dashboard photo are on their way from the driver; share them if they have arrived. Ask: 1) Do they want roadside help or collection, and who will come and roughly when? 2) Who should get the keys? The driver must hand over in person to a named person. 3) Tell them the 21 Oct 12:00–16:00 Hamburg delivery will not happen. Do not promise a new date until the recovery plan is known. Do not say the car is safe to drive.

input.what_happens_next: I pass the location pin and photo to you as soon as the driver sends them. You call the customer.
input.what_happens_after: The customer's recovery instruction goes on the order. The driver is told who is collecting the car and when. A new delivery date is proposed separately.
